=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:139 and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:139 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `mine: true` filter excludes older per-wait checkers created by other sessions, so zombie cleanup can report zero archived while those checkers remain.
  WHY: The fallback only drops `mine` on an API error, not on a successful but over-filtered result; all reporting reviewers identify this as a major defect.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:139 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `limit: 100` cap can omit zombie sessions when the session listing exceeds 100 entries.
  WHY: The cleanup can silently miss older sessions and fail to converge even if the `mine` filter is removed.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:129 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The wording groups `send_later` check-ins and `create_trigger` instruction triggers as deletion targets, although `delete_trigger` does not remove `send_later` wakes.
  WHY: An implementer may expect `delete_trigger` to clear periodic check-ins and may incorrectly conclude the wait-id guard is unnecessary.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:128 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A `get_session` failure can fall through to creating a new checker while the recorded checker may still be live.
  WHY: A transient API error can leave two active checkers, breaking the one-checker-per-project invariant.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (template mirror) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The template copy carries the same checker-lifecycle changes, so fixing only the root command would break the byte-identical template parity contract.
  WHY: The root and template copies must be updated together to preserve the documented parity invariant.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:134 and 139 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The unconditional `list_sessions` and `list_triggers` cleanup has no documented handling for rate limits or failed calls.
  WHY: A rate-limit response can silently prevent cleanup while the stage proceeds as if cleanup succeeded.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:128 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The depth-limit refusal sets `Checker session: none`, but the resume block lacks a checker ID that the next stage's arming step assumes.
  WHY: The next stage may be unable to reuse or create a checker, causing duplicates or a stall.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:15 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The resume-hygiene and zombie-cleanup wording changes the checker-lifecycle contract from the prior per-wait design, while template and test coverage are incomplete.
  WHY: The changed cleanup scope may regress synchronization and tests.
- tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py:194-201 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `test_zombie_checkers_are_cleaned_up` does not assert that `mine: true` is absent or that an unfiltered listing is used.
  WHY: The test can pass while the zombie-cleanup scoping bug remains.
- docs/INVENTORY.md (not in PR diff) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `docs/INVENTORY.md` omits `.github/workflows/claude-issue-intake.yml`, `scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh`, `scripts/claude_issue_intake.sh`, and `scripts/claude_issue_route.py`, causing the inventory parity lint check to fail.
  WHY: The failing required lint check blocks merge; reviewers classify this pre-existing gap as a blocker.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Update docs/INVENTORY.md to include all project files."
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails because the inventory omits `.github/workflows/claude-issue-intake.yml`, `scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh`, `scripts/claude_issue_intake.sh`, and `scripts/claude_issue_route.py`, which README.md and agents.md reference.
- requirement: "Changes made" in PR description — "tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py adds 4 contract tests: one checker per project, zombie cleanup, superseded waits, and the loud depth-limit refusal."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py (specifically the four new tests added in this PR).
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `test_zombie_checkers_are_cleaned_up` (lines 194-201) does not assert `"mine: true" not in text` or an equivalent guard against the scoping bug, so restoring `mine: true` would pass all four tests.
- requirement: PR description — "A depth-limit refusal is a loud `Status: BLOCKED` with a push notification and a ready-to-paste `— resume.` block. It never falls back to a session-local cron; the local fallbacks now apply only when the tools are missing."
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md, the "Refused at the depth limit" paragraph and the Fallbacks section.
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The Fallbacks section was not modified in the diff and may retain prior `CronCreate` session-local fallback language; the new "Refused at the depth limit" paragraph explicitly overrides it, and this reviewer states the requirement is met without a code change.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
